record.question: Pick out one of the following acts which has not been repealed by the enactment of the Mizoram(Land Revenue) Act, 2013.
options: The Lushai Hills District (House Site) Act, 1953.
The Mizoram Land Holding and Settlement Act, 2000.
The Mizo District (Land and Revenue) Act, 1956.
The Mizoram (Restriction on use of Transferred Lands) Act, 2002.
record.explanation: The Mizoram (Restriction on use of Transferred Lands) Act, 2002 is a separate enactment that the 2013 Land Revenue Act does not repeal, while the other three older land acts are the ones it replaces.
